u4-p39-ocr0.sourceEnglish: By-and-by, Tom took Becky's candle and blew it out. This economy meant so much! Words were not needed. Becky understood, and her hope died again. She knew that Tom had a whole candle and three or four pieces in his pockets-yet he must economize.
u4-p39-ocr0.translation: 过了一会儿，汤姆拿过贝琪的蜡烛，把它吹灭了。这种节省意味着太多。无需言语，贝琪便明白了，她的希望再次破灭。她知道汤姆口袋里还有一整支蜡烛和三四小截，可他仍不得不节省。

u4-p39-ocr3.sourceEnglish: By-and-by, fatigue began to assert its claims; the children tried to pay attention, for it was dreadful to think of sitting down when time was grown to be so precious, moving, in some direction, in any direction, was at least progress and might bear fruit; but to sit down was to invite death and shorten its pursuit.
u4-p39-ocr3.translation: 渐渐地，疲劳开始占据上风。孩子们努力振作精神，因为时间如此宝贵，想到停下来就令人恐惧。朝一个方向，朝任何方向走，至少都是前进，也许会有结果；坐下来却像是在招来死亡，让它更快追上自己。

u4-p39-ocr7.sourceEnglish: At last Becky's frail limbs refused to carry her farther. She sat down. Tom rested with her, and they talked of home, and the friends there, and the comfortable beds and, above all, the light! Becky cried, and Tom tried to think of some way of comforting her, but all his encouragements were grown threadbare with use, and sounded like sarcasms. Fatigue bore so heavily upon Becky that she drowsed off to sleep. Tom was grateful. He sat looking
u4-p39-ocr7.translation: 终于，贝琪虚弱的双腿再也支撑不了她，她坐了下来。汤姆陪她休息，他们谈起家、家里的朋友、舒服的床，尤其是光明。贝琪哭了，汤姆努力想办法安慰她，但那些鼓励的话已经说得太多，听起来反像讽刺。疲惫重重压着贝琪，她终于昏昏睡去。汤姆对此心怀感激。他坐在那里望着……（原图在此处截断。）

u5-p168-ocr8.sourceEnglish: Alliteration Definition: Alliteration is a figure of speech in which the same sound repeats in a group of words for the effects of rhythm and musicality, emphasis and memorability, cohesion and unity, mood and tone and intensifying imagery.
u5-p168-ocr8.translation: 头韵。定义：在一组词语中重复相同的语音，以产生节奏感和音乐美，突出重点、加深记忆，形成衔接与统一，营造情绪和语调，并强化意象。

u5-p168-ocr29.sourceEnglish: Example: In "board and bed and congenial company, safe from Boreas and bluecoats," the alliteration turns Soapy's wish for imprisonment into a rhythmic, almost comic "dream package," making his desperate situation sound light-hearted and ironic.
u5-p168-ocr29.translation: 例子：“食宿与合得来的同伴，避开北风和蓝制服警察”中的头韵，把苏比渴望入狱的心愿变成节奏鲜明、近乎滑稽的“梦想套餐”，使他的绝境听起来轻快而充满反讽。

u5-p177-ocr2.sourceEnglish: Understatement Definition: Understatement is a figure of speech in which something is expressed less strongly than would be expected, or in which something is presented as being smaller, worse, or lesser than it really is. Typically, understatement is used to call attention to the very quality it pretends to downplay.
u5-p177-ocr2.translation: 低调陈述。定义：以比预期更弱的语气表达某事，或把某事说得比实际更小、更差或更轻。通常借表面的淡化，引起人们对某一特质的注意。

u5-p177-ocr21.sourceEnglish: Example: The sentence "The hibernatorial ambitions of Soapy were not of the highest" is a clear example of understatement. By describing Soapy's desperate wish to spend the winter in prison as merely "not of the highest," the narrator deliberately plays down the seriousness of his situation. The formal, almost mock- academic phrase "hibernatorial ambitions" makes his goal sound comically mild and respectable, which contrasts sharply with the grim reality of homelessness and incarceration and thus creates ironic humour.
u5-p177-ocr21.translation: 例子：“苏比对于过冬的愿望，并不怎么高”是典型的低调陈述。叙述者把他迫切希望在监狱里度过寒冬的心愿，仅仅说成“并不怎么高”，故意淡化其处境的严重性。“过冬的愿望”这种正式、近乎戏仿学术的措辞，让他的目标听起来温和而体面，与无家可归和被囚禁的残酷现实形成鲜明对照，从而产生反讽式幽默。

The formal, almost mock- academic phrase "hibernatorial ambitions" makes his goal sound comically mild and respectable, which contrasts sharply with the grim reality of homelessness and incarceration and thus creates ironic humour.
u5-p177-ocr25.translation: 例子：“苏比对于过冬的愿望，并不怎么高”是典型的低调陈述。叙述者把他迫切希望在监狱里度过寒冬的心愿，仅仅说成“并不怎么高”，故意淡化其处境的严重性。“过冬的愿望”这种正式、近乎戏仿学术的措辞，让他的目标听起来温和而体面，与无家可归和被囚禁的残酷现实形成鲜明对照，从而产生反讽式幽默。

u5-p183-ocr5.sourceEnglish: David Copperfield, Charles Dickens 'She was more than human to me. She was a Fairy, a Sylph, I don't know what she was...I was swallowed up in an abyss of love in an instant. u2-p15-img-definition.sourceEnglish: Headmaster Albus Dumbledore: His first name is from the Latin word alba, “white.” His last name, according to Rowling interviews, is Old English for “bumblebee.” In color symbolism, white often stands for purity, so the headmaster’s name suggests honor and a hard-working nature (“busy as a bee”).
u2-p15-img-definition.translation: 校长阿不思·邓布利多：他的名字 Albus 源于拉丁语 alba，意为“白色”。据罗琳的访谈，Dumbledore 在古英语中意为“大黄蜂”。在色彩象征中，白色常代表纯洁，因此校长的名字使人联想到荣誉以及像蜜蜂一样勤勉的品质。

u4-p23-img2.sourceEnglish: "You know I hate, detest, and can't bear a lie, not because I am straighter than the rest of us, but simply because it appalls me. There is a taint of death, a flavour of mortality in lies-which is exactly what I hate and detest in the world-what I want to forget."
u4-p23-img2.translation: 你知道，我憎恶谎言，讨厌谎言，根本无法忍受谎言；不是因为我比别人更正直，而只是因为谎言让我惊骇。谎言里有一种死亡的污点，一股生命终将消逝的气息——那恰恰是这世上我痛恨、厌恶、想要忘却的东西。

u4-p30-img11.sourceEnglish: You are not the kind of guy who would be at a place like this at this time of the morning. But you are here, and you cannot say that the terrain is entirely unfamiliar, although the details are a little fuzzy. You are at a nightclub talking to a girl with a shaved head. The club is either the Bimbo Box or the Lizard Lounge, It might all come a little clearer if you could slip into the bathroom and do a little more Bolivian Marching Powder. There is a small voice inside of you insisting that this epidemic lack of clarity is the result of too much of that already, but you are not yet willing to listen to that voice, the night has already turned on that imperceptible pivot where two A.M. changes to six A.M.
u4-p30-img11.translation: 你不是那种会在清晨这个时候待在这种地方的人。可你偏偏就在这里，而且不能说对这里全然陌生，只不过细节有些模糊。你正在一家夜总会里，同一个剃光头发的姑娘聊天。这里不是“宾博盒子”，就是“蜥蜴酒吧”。如果能溜进洗手间，再吸一点所谓的“玻利维亚行军粉”——可卡因——也许一切会清楚些。你心里有个微弱的声音坚持说，这种无处不在的混沌恰恰是吸得太多造成的，可你还不愿意听它。夜晚已经越过那个难以察觉的转折点，凌晨两点就这样变成了早上六点。

u4-p31-img1.sourceEnglish: "Looks like rain," you mutter to yourself.
u4-p31-img1.translation: “看样子要下雨了。”你低声对自己说。

u4-p31-img2.sourceEnglish: What we do if it really chucks it down?
u4-p31-img2.translation: 要是真下起倾盆大雨，我们该怎么办？

u4-p31-img3.sourceEnglish: You open your eyes so that only a slender chink of light seeps in, and peer at the gingko trees in front of the Provincial Office. As though there, between those branches, the wind is about to take on visible form. As though the raindrops suspended in the air, held breath before the plunge, are on the cusp of trembling down, glittering like jewels.
u4-p31-img3.translation: 你微微睁开眼，只让一线光透进来，眯眼望着道厅前的银杏树。仿佛在那些枝条之间，风就要显出可见的形状。仿佛悬在空中的雨滴，在坠落前屏住了呼吸，正要颤巍巍地落下，像珠宝一样闪闪发亮。

u4-p32-img2.sourceEnglish: You were on your way home when you died.
u4-p32-img2.translation: 你死的时候，正在回家的路上。

u4-p32-img3.sourceEnglish: It was a car accident. Nothing particularly remarkable, but fatal nonetheless. You left behind a wife and two children. It was a painless death. The EMTs tried their best to save you, but to no avail. Your body was so utterly shattered you were better off, trust me.
u4-p32-img3.translation: 那是一场车祸。没什么特别之处，却终究致命。你留下了妻子和两个孩子。死亡并没有让你感到痛苦。急救人员尽了全力抢救你，却无济于事。你的身体已经损伤得太严重，活下来反而更糟，相信我。

u4-p32-img6.sourceEnglish: And that's when you met me.

u4-p32-img7.sourceEnglish: "What... what happened?" You asked. "Where am I?"
u4-p32-img7.translation: “发……发生了什么？”你问，“我在哪里？”

u4-p32-img8.sourceEnglish: "You died," I said, matter-of-factly. No point in mincing words.
u4-p32-img8.translation: “你死了。”我平静地说。没有必要拐弯抹角。

u4-p33-img4.sourceEnglish: You are about to begin reading Italo Calvino's new novel, If on a winter's night a traveler. Relax. Concentrate. Dispel every other thought. Let the world around you fade. Best to close the door; the TV is always on in the next room. Tell the others right away, "No, I don't want to watch TV!" Raise your voice-they won't hear you otherwise-"I'm reading! I don't want to be disturbed!" Maybe they haven't heard you, with all that racket; speak louder, yell: "I'm beginning to read Italo Calvino's new novel!" Or if you prefer, don't say anything; just hope they'll leave you alone.
u4-p33-img4.translation: 你即将开始阅读伊塔洛·卡尔维诺的新小说《如果在冬夜，一个旅人》。放松。集中精神。排除其他一切念头。让周围的世界淡去。最好把门关上；隔壁房间的电视总开着。马上告诉其他人：“不，我不想看电视！”提高声音——不然他们听不见——“我在看书！我不想受打扰！”这么吵，他们也许没听见；再大点声，喊出来：“我要开始读伊塔洛·卡尔维诺的新小说了！”或者，如果你愿意，什么也别说；只希望他们别来烦你。

Best to close the door; the TV is always on in the next room. Tell the others right away, "No, I don't want to watch TV!" Raise your voice-they won't hear you otherwise-"I'm reading! I don't want to be disturbed!" Maybe they haven't heard you, with all that racket; speak louder, yell: "I'm beginning to read Italo Calvino's new novel!" Or if you prefer, don't say anything; just hope they'll leave you alone.

u4-p34-img1.sourceEnglish: “If you really want to hear about it, the first thing you’ll probably want to know is where I was born, an what my lousy childhood was like, and how my parents were occupied and all before they had me, and all that David Copperfield kind of crap, but I don’t feel like going into it, if you want to know the truth.”
u4-p34-img1.translation: 如果你真想听这件事，你大概首先会想知道我生在什么地方，我那糟透了的童年是什么样，我父母生我以前都忙些什么，以及诸如此类像《大卫·科波菲尔》那样的废话。可说实在的，我不想细谈这些。

u4-p47-img6.sourceEnglish: It was ten o'clock on the evening of the same day, and the permanent residents of the household on the mountain were restored to routines and sobriety. Jane, on the other hand, sat by herself in the kitchen, a glass of Scotch before her on the cleanly wiped table, going deeper and deeper into a mood she could recognize only as unfamiliar. She could not describe it; it was both frightening and satisfying. It was like letting go and being taken somewhere. She tried to trace it back. When, exactly, had it started?
u4-p47-img6.translation: 当天晚上十点，山上那户人家的常住成员已经恢复了平日的作息，也清醒了过来。简却独自坐在厨房里，面前擦得干干净净的桌上放着一杯苏格兰威士忌。她越来越深地陷入一种情绪，对它，她只能说是陌生。她无法形容那种感觉；它既让人害怕，又让人满足。仿佛松开了手，任由自己被带往某处。她试着追溯这种感觉。它究竟是从什么时候开始的？

u4-p103-img9.translation: 欧内斯特·海明威（作家姓名）。

u4-p104-img1.sourceEnglish: From reading Rudyard Kipling Hemingway absorbed the practice of shortening prose as much as it could take. Of the concept of omission, Hemingway wrote in “The Art of the Short Story”: “You could omit anything if you knew that you omitted and the omitted part would strengthen the story and make people feel something more than they understood.”
u4-p104-img1.translation: 海明威从阅读鲁德亚德·吉卜林的作品中，学会了在不损害作品的前提下尽量精简散文。谈到“省略”这一观念，他在《短篇小说的艺术》中写道：“只要你清楚自己省略的是什么，就可以省去任何东西；被省去的部分会增强故事的力量，使读者感受到的比他们理解到的更多。”

u4-p105-img1.sourceEnglish: His style added to the aesthetic: using “declarative sentences and direct representations of the visible world” with simple and plain language, Hemingway became “the most influential prose stylist in the twentieth century” according to biographer Meyers.
u4-p105-img1.translation: 他的文风也形成了这种美学：用简洁、朴实的语言写出“陈述句，直接呈现可见的世界”。据传记作家迈耶斯所说，海明威因此成为“二十世纪最有影响力的散文文体家”。

u4-p105-img6.sourceEnglish: Zoe Trodd believes that Hemingway’s iceberg theory “demanded that the reader feel the whole story” and that the reader is meant to “fill the gaps left by his omissions with their feelings”.
u4-p105-img6.translation: 佐伊·特罗德认为，海明威的冰山理论“要求读者感受到整个故事”，让读者“用自己的感受填补他省略之处留下的空白”。

u5-p167-img1.sourceEnglish: When to the sessions of sweet silent thought I summon up remembrance of things past, I sigh the lack of many a thing I sought, And with old woes new wail my dear time's waste: Then can I drown an eye, unused to flow, For precious friends hid in death's dateless night, And weep afresh love's long since cancell'd woe, And moan the expense of many a vanish'd sight: Then can I grieve at grievances foregone,
u5-p167-img1.translation: 当我在甜美而静谧的沉思中，召回往昔的种种记忆，我为许多曾经追求而未曾得到的事物叹息，又以旧日的哀伤，为珍贵年华的虚度重新悲泣。于是，我那不惯流泪的眼睛，也会为隐没在死亡无尽长夜中的挚友而湿润；为早已消逝的爱情之痛再度流泪，为许多不复存在的景象而哀叹。于是，我又为早已过去的悲伤重新悲伤。

u5-p175-ocr0.translation: BOOM：轰的一声；WOW：哇，表示惊叹；OMG：Oh my God 的缩写，意为“天啊”。

u5-p175-ocr1.translation: OOPS：哎呀，表示出了小差错或发生意外。

u5-p175-ocr2.translation: SPLAT：啪嗒、啪叽，表示湿物撞上或落下的声音；ZAP：滋啪，表示电击或能量击中的声音。

u5-p175-ocr3.translation: POP：啵、砰，表示爆裂或弹开的短促声音；WHAM：砰，表示猛烈撞击。

u5-p175-ocr4.translation: CRASH：哗啦、轰隆，表示碰撞、坠落或碎裂的声音。

u5-p175-ocr5.translation: POW：砰，常在漫画中表示拳头或物体击中的声音。

u5-p175-ocr8.translation: BANG：砰；WTF：What the fuck 的缩写，是粗俗的惊讶或恼怒感叹，近于“搞什么鬼”；HAHA：哈哈；YEAH：耶、好啊。

u2-p16-img-definition.sourceEnglish: Sirius Black: His first name is the "Dog Star," brightest in the Canis Major (Great Dog) constellation. There are at least two three stars in the Sirius system, and the brightest is Sirius A; it is 10 times brighter than our sun. This star was given god status among the ancient Egyptians and later the Greeks. The dog represented by the constellation was the faithful companion to Orion the hunter, who also is a constellation. Appropriate for a wizard who can transform into a dog. Black suggests the dark nature that wizards unaware of Sirius' innocence assign to him. It also could suggest "black dog," the form he takes when his uses his skill as an Animagus.
u2-p16-img-definition.translation: 小天狼星·布莱克：他的名字 Sirius 指的是“天狼星”，即大犬座中最明亮的恒星。天狼星系统中至少有两三颗恒星，最亮的是天狼星 A；它比太阳亮十倍。古埃及人以及后来的古希腊人曾将这颗星奉为神。这个星座所代表的狗，是猎人俄里翁忠实的伙伴；俄里翁本身也对应一个星座。这样的名字很适合一个能变成狗的巫师。Black（黑色）暗示了那些不知道他清白的巫师强加给他的黑暗本性，也可能指“黑狗”——他施展阿尼马格斯变形能力时所呈现的形态。
